release_name: Tell the new worker to activate only once it can hear us
notes: Closes the last known hole in the update path. SKIP_WAITING was posted to reg.installing||reg.waiting the moment reg.update() resolved. A worker that is still INSTALLING may not have its message handler running yet, so the message could simply be dropped - the worker then sat in waiting forever, no controllerchange fired, and the user waited out the full give-up timeout for an update that had actually downloaded fine. The message is now held until the worker reports installed, and updatefound is armed BEFORE calling update() because update() can resolve before the new worker appears. Verified: with a worker in the installing state nothing is posted, and exactly one SKIP_WAITING is sent the moment it reaches installed; a worker already installed is still told immediately. This bug predates the v27.6.14 rewrite - it was flagged there rather than fixed, which left the mechanism that delivers every other fix with a known hole. No data change: 426 rows.
